sensor.name: CUST - Comply reports older than 10 days
sensor.description: This report will parse the Comply scan and returns True/False is the scan is older than 10 days. To be used for Compliance scan monitoring.

sensor_query.query:
import tanium import os import time import datetime
#Value to set based on requirements. max_age=10
#Create list where we will store the filenames found files = [] age_days=0
if tanium.os_help.is_windows(): results_folder = tanium.client.get_client_dir() + "\\Tools\\Comply\\results"
if tanium.os_help.is_mac(): results_folder = tanium.client.get_client_dir() + "/Tools/Comply/results"
if tanium.os_help.is_linux(): results_folder = tanium.client.get_client_dir() + "/Tools/Comply/results"
suffix = "aggregate.txt"
#Slice the file found in 3 part (r)oot, (d)irectory and (f)ilename for r, d, f in os.walk(results_folder): for file in f: if file.endswith(suffix): files.append(os.path.join(r, file)) #rebuild full file name in list created earlier
for f in files:
#get time stamp of file and convert to compare with today's date file_date = time.ctime(os.path.getmtime(f)) try: file_date = datetime.datetime.strptime(file_date, "%a %b %d %H:%M:%S %Y") file_date=str(file_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')) today_date=str(datetime.date.today()) date_format = "%Y-%m-%d" a = datetime.datetime.strptime(file_date, date_format) b = datetime.datetime.strptime(today_date, date_format) age_days=str(b-a) age_days=age_days.split(' day')[0] if age_days.startswith('0'): age_days=0 except: import traceback #tanium.results.add(traceback.format_exc())
#get hash report_hash = os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(f))
#get type of scan like joval,cis-cat or scc if tanium.os_help.is_windows(): scan_type = os.path.dirname(f).split('\\')[-2] if tanium.os_help.is_mac(): scan_type = os.path.dirname(f).split('/')[-2] if tanium.os_help.is_linux(): scan_type = os.path.dirname(f).split('/')[-2]
if int(age_days) >= int(max_age): results=str(scan_type)+"|"+str(report_hash)+"|True" tanium.results.add(results) else: results=str(scan_type)+"|"+str(report_hash)+"|False" tanium.results.add(results)
